# Version 4.150.1
> **Native safety fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 fixes unsafe cleanup of corrupt text data and improves clipped render-pass handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped render passes respect cleared stencil bounds** — Includes the upstream m150 correction that checks clipped render-pass bounds against the stencil area that was cleared. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))

## Security

- **Corrupt serialized text cleans up safely** — Fixes destruction ordering in Skia's SubRunAllocator to prevent a use-after-free and wild free when malformed Slug data fails to deserialize. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1 with this SkiaSharp servicing release.
